mapper.select: -- file name: SampleMapper.xml -- query id: getArea select comm_cd as area_code , comm_cd_nm as area_name from comm_cd where use_yn = 'Y' and comm_grp_cd = 'CM009' order by sort_val ;

-- file name: SampleMapper.xml -- query id: getHospitalInfo select a.hospital_id , coalesce(min(a.hospital_nm), a.hospital_id::text) as institution_name , 'HOSPITAL' as institution_type , min(a.sub_dvsn_nm) as city_name , min(a.nat_cd) as nation_code , min(a.nat_nm) as nation_name , min(a.nat_area_cd) as area_code , null::timestamptz as registration_date , null::timestamptz as expiration_date , '' as contact_email , case when exists ( select 1 from gmcs_main_daily b where b.hospital_id = a.hospital_id ) then 'LIS' else 'HL7' end as data_type from mv_hospital_region as a where a.hospital_id = #{hospitalId}::uuid group by a.hospital_id ;

-- file name: SampleMapper.xml -- query id: getClabInfo select a.clab_id , case when count(c.hospital_id) > 0 then string_agg(distinct d.hospital_nm, ' / ' order by d.hospital_nm) else min(a.clab_nm) end as institution_name , case when count(c.hospital_id) > 0 then 'AFFILIATED' else 'CLAB' end as institution_type , min(a.sub_dvsn_nm) as city_name , min(a.nat_cd) as nation_code , min(a.nat_nm) as nation_name , min(a.nat_area_cd) as area_code , min(b.provide_start_dt) as registration_date , max(b.provide_end_dt) as contract_expiration_date , min(a.contact_email) as contact_email , case when exists ( select 1 from gmcs_main_daily b where b.clab_id = a.clab_id ) then 'LIS' else 'HL7' end as data_type from mv_clab_region as a left outer join mv_gmcs_clab_contract as b on a.clab_id = b.clab_id and current_date between b.provide_start_dt and b.provide_end_dt left outer join mv_clab_affiliated_hospital as c on c.clab_id = a.clab_id and c.hospital_id is not null left outer join mv_hospital_region as d on d.hospital_id = c.hospital_id where a.clab_id = #{clabId} group by a.clab_id ;

-- file name: SampleMapper.xml -- query id: getNationInfo with cte_nation_and_sub_dvsn as materialized ( select a.nat_info_no , a.nat_area_cd , a.nat_cd , a.nat_nm , a.nat_ko_nm , a.latud , a.lngtud , b.sub_dvsn_no , b.sub_dvsn_cd , b.sub_dvsn_nm , b.sub_dvsn_ko_nm from nation_info as a inner join nation_sub_dvsn_info as b on a.nat_info_no = b.nat_info_no where a.use_yn = 'Y' and b.use_yn = 'Y' and a.nat_area_cd is not null ) select a.nat_info_no as nation_info_no , a.nat_cd as nation_code , case when coalesce(#{lang},'en') = 'ko' then a.nat_ko_nm else a.nat_nm end as nation_name , a.latud as latitude , a.lngtud as longitude , b.comm_cd as area_code , case when coalesce(#{lang},'en') = 'ko' then cond_1_val else comm_cd_nm end as area_name , a.sub_dvsn_no as nation_region_no , a.sub_dvsn_cd as nation_region_code , case when coalesce(#{lang},'en') = 'ko' then a.sub_dvsn_ko_nm else sub_dvsn_nm end as nation_region_name , case when c.country_no is null then 0 else 1 end as is_participating from cte_nation_and_sub_dvsn as a inner join comm_cd as b on a.nat_area_cd = b.comm_cd and b.comm_grp_cd = 'CM009' and b.use_yn = 'Y' left outer join ( select country_no from gmcs_test_monthly where target_system_code = 'GMCS' group by country_no ) as c on c.country_no = a.nat_info_no where 1 = 1 ;
